description: Event/decision log for scripts/run_scalp_paper.py's short-horizon scalper (paper mode): one JSON object per line, every entry carrying ts + event plus event-specific fields (start, entry, limit_placed, fill, missed, exit, ws_reconnect, radar_state, kill_file_stop, daily_loss_stop, refused_start). Line-delimited JSON, not CSV -- scripts/data_quality.py's column-based checks are explicitly out of scope for jsonl (see that script's own docstring); this schema exists so the file resolves to a named dataset instead of schema_undefined.
source: scripts/run_scalp_paper.py's self.log(event, **kw) -> {"ts": time.time(), "event": event, **kw}, appended on every trade/decision (see the script's module docstring: 'Every trade and decision appended to data/scalp_paper.jsonl').
retention: append-only, one process run's log; paper_logs/scalp_paper.jsonl is the owner-PC operational copy this checkout mirrors, data/scalp_paper.jsonl is this checkout's own copy.
known_defects: jsonl, not CSV -- data_quality.py treats jsonl as out of scope for its column-based row checks (counted in files_checked, never flagged), consistent with schema/venue_survey.json's precedent

every line shares 'ts' (epoch seconds float) and 'event' (string), but the remaining fields differ per event type -- see scripts/run_scalp_paper.py's self.log() call sites for the exact field set per event (e.g. 'entry' carries side/price/size/signal_bps/bid/ask; 'exit' carries exit_kind/PnL; 'start' carries the full argparse Namespace)

'start' event's PnL/loss-cap fields (daily_loss_cap, notional, etc.) come directly from CLI args at process launch -- a change in launch parameters between runs is only visible by re-reading each run's own 'start' line, not inferable from later rows
